repos.notes: Survey/forms product with a large public OpenAPI spec at the repo root (openapi.yml) containing many genuinely ambiguous field names — a good stress test for confidence scoring. Real Stripe billing exists but only under the proprietary ee/billing subtree, so it is intentionally excluded from ground truth here. Real sign-up PII collection goes through Zod-validated Next.js Server Actions rather than req.body/request.json(), which Layer 1 does not parse today — a genuine, verified recall gap captured below.

methodology: Each repo is shallow-cloned at test time via `git fetch --depth 1 origin <pinnedSha>` into scratch space, never vendored into this repository. Ground-truth entries in expected-findings/<name>.json are matched loosely by {filePattern, lineRange, dataCategory, minConfidence} against actual scan output — never by exact description text, so internal rule refactors don't make the corpus brittle. Recall against this manifest is a hard regression gate (see scripts/scoreCorpus.ts); precision is tracked but held to a looser bar, since new true positives beyond what's hand-curated here are welcome, not a regression.
